## Summary

**File modified:** `src/main/java/com/garbagemule/MobArena/ArenaListener.java`

**Modification:** In the food level change event handler, the condition for cancelling the event was changed from checking only `lockFoodLevel` to checking both `arena.inArena(p) && lockFoodLevel`.

**Relationship/Reasoning:** Previously, when the arena was running and food level locking was enabled, the event was cancelled for *any* player on the server, regardless of whether they were actually participating in the arena. This caused the food level lock to incorrectly affect all players, not just those inside the arena. The fix adds a check to verify that the player triggering the event (`p`) is actually in the arena (`arena.inArena(p)`) before cancelling the event, ensuring the food level lock only applies to players participating in the arena and not to bystanders elsewhere on the server.
